attempt: Sample arbitrary rectangles from the approved tapered trunk atlas on newly authored branch boxes, while relying on connected centerlines and in-bounds UV validation.
reason_failed: The trunk atlas includes tapered alpha masks for quad silhouettes. Some rectangular branch side/cap crops contained transparency, so geometrically connected wooden segments appeared severed. The native node/UV validator did not detect the material coverage defect.
environment: Windows; Blockbench Hytale prop format; Hytale 0.7.2; Zytale autumn maple refinement 1.12.1
error_signature: Wood-only preview showed separated-looking branch segments despite connected geometry; no native schema error.
conditions: Reusing alpha-masked trunk art for solid branch boxes
Foliage can hide structural defects during a full-tree preview
workaround: Select fully opaque bark rectangles for every branch side and end cap, retain overlap between segments and solid junction collars, and inspect a wood-only native preview. Final tests passed 441 connection checks across S/M/L and opaque alpha coverage for every tested branch face. Client visual acceptance remains pending.
